Table 1 values (age 24 +- 4, 16 women, 3 left-handed, speed 0.70 +- 0.16 m/s) are reproduced from all 32 participants within rounding.
The paper's gait outcomes (step-duration variability, sacral excursion variability) come from the insole and IMU recordings, which are not part of the converted file, so they are not reproduced.
